expectedDescription: Asked the Gillespie County Commissioners Court on October 10, 2022 to set pay for election workers, the first year the county put them on its payroll. She proposed $10.25 an hour for new election clerks, $11.25 for experienced clerks, and $11.50 for election judges. The court approved her rates and added a 5 percent raise for bilingual clerks and judges.
